sentences.text:
Yugal Kishore Chauhan vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 17 January,
2024

Author: Parth Prateem Sahu
Bench: Parth Prateem Sahu

N
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Mcrc No. 368 of 2024

Yugal Kishore Chauhan S/o Dharmendra Chauhan Aged About 28
 Years R/o Shivnagar, Sarora, Police Station Urla, District- Raipur,
 Chhattisgarh.

---- Applic
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh Through Station House Officer, Police Station-
 Urla, District- Raipur, Chhattisgarh.
 ---- Non-applica
 For applicant : Ms. Ritika Verma, Advocate

For State : Mr. Ankur Kashyap,
 Dy. Government Advocate

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he was arrested in connection with Crime No. 349 of 2023 registered at Police Station Urla ,
District - Raipur (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 376, 376 (2)(n) of I.P.C. & Section 4, 6 of POCSO Act, 2012.

2. Learned counsel for applicant submits that first bail application was withdrawn with liberty to repeat the prayer after examination of victim and now victim has been examined before the learned Court below.
3. Learned State counsel submits that the deposition of victim which is relied upon by learned counsel for applicant, victim stood with allegation of sexual intercourse.
Victim was aged about 15 years on the date of incident.

sentences.text: 4. I have heard learned counsel for parties and also perused the documents available with this bail application.

5. Taking into consideration material available in the application, submission of learned counsel for the parties, in particular considering deposition of victim, I am not inclined to admit this second bail application.
6. Accordingly, this second bail application is dismissed.

Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
